obfuscation_indicators: may not be available on acceptable terms
risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful revenue, customer concentration, margin, and tax-loss figures, but relies heavily on conditional projections and broad assumptions regarding growth, customer adoption, margins, and financing. Material risks include dependence on a few customers, rare-earth supply and cost volatility, potential financing constraints, contractual cash requirements, and uncertainty over utilization of tax-loss carryforwards.
